title: Visual builder module hover CSS and content patch

entries.summary: Modules can set design_hover (Normal/Hover in Design). Compiled :hover rules include .btn and .public-site so button themes do not win. Hover is not per-device.
Content field edits replace the selected .cms-layout-module inner HTML (rebind inline edit and canvas links only). Carousel still does a full canvas render.
No schema change. design_hover is another optional key on modules inside layout_json; CSS remains derived at render.
cms-builder-drag-column-size sets Hover Accent on Module A, patches heading/text in place, and asserts :hover in editor and public stylesheets.
